data.name: Oobe_LegalDescription
data.value: Expand and read both notes below, then tick your agreement

data.name: Oobe_PrivacyPolicyBody
data.value:
Corkboard collects only what it needs to work and to count itself. Here is the whole list.
· Online status: on launch it reports a device id generated randomly on this machine plus the device type, so we can count how many people are online. That id is not tied to your account and carries no hardware details. · Usage counters: only three incrementing numbers — launches, notes added, exports. The content of your notes is never recorded. · Rough location: the server maps the request address to a city-level region. The client never sends your IP or city. · Account: when you sign in with a SECTL account the credentials stay on this machine and are wiped on sign-out.
All of the reporting above can be made anonymous or switched off entirely in Settings → Basic. Your notes, settings and screenshots live only on your own disk; cloud sync is off by default and only uploads after you sign in and turn it on.

data.name: Oobe_EulaBody
data.value:
Corkboard is released under the GNU GPLv3, so you may use, modify and redistribute it as that licence allows.
· This is a desktop tool for keeping track of homework. It comes as is, without any warranty, and is not responsible for missed homework or lost data. · Please do not use it for unlawful content, or to get around your school's legitimate rules. · The program may be changed, paused or discontinued at any time. · If these terms or the privacy policy change in substance, you will be asked to confirm again on the next launch.
Continuing to use it means you understand and accept the above.
